description: Multi-phase plans currently in flight. Each phase references roadmap item ids; the activePhase section breaks the current phase into concrete tasks with status. Survives conversation compactions — a fresh session can pick up by reading this file.

phases.title: Toolbox hooks and the context map
phases.notes: Edicts 0016 (the toolbox fires itself) and 0015 (the context map). 0016's hook kit comes first; 0015's context hook is a feature of it.

activePhase.title: Toolbox hooks and the context map
activePhase.goal: Build edicts 0016 and 0015 to their acceptance criteria: a stdlib hook kit that makes Daedalus's tools fire at exact events, and an exact context map with planned compaction, recovery and recall.
activePhase.sequencing: Kit first (T-h1, T-h2), then 0015's measuring and views (T-c1..T-c2) so the context feature has a home, then the 0016 triggers (T-h3..T-h7) and 0015's plan, nudges, recovery and recall (T-c3..T-c5), docs last (T-h8, covering both edicts). Rebase on the night shift's work; it owns ophanic/, cli/oph.py and the end of doctor.run_checks.

tasks.details: Top-level stdlib package + daedalus-hook script; <=40 ms median subprocess on the no-feature event; HOOKS gains a matcher; board and capture move onto it; Stop/PreCompact never print. | PR #74 ready: Momus 4 rounds (trials 2026-10-15-hook-kit.md), CI green. Includes the shell reader (shell.parse).
tasks.resolution: PR #74, merged to main at 6c60565 (head 9527cac): daedalus_hookkit (dispatchers, state with lock, noise budget, heartbeat, quote-aware shell.parse). Momus: 4 review rounds plus confirmation (trial 2026-10-15-hook-kit.md).
